english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an orbiting body, including a man-made one when the context is clear.
Use this when discussing a natural satellite of another planet, such as one of Jupiter's moons, usually with the planet named in context.

examples.english: The satellite will pass over Hong Kong tonight.
examples.traditional: 衛星今晚會掠過香港上空。
examples.jyutping: wai6 sing1 gam1 maan5 wui5 loek6 gwo3 hoeng1 gong2 soeng6 hung1

examples.english: Jupiter has a moon called Europa.
examples.traditional: 木星有粒衛星叫木衛二。
examples.jyutping: muk6 sing1 jau5 nap1 wai6 sing1 giu3 muk6 wai6 ji6
